$comment: The extras of omx-balancer's declaration: what its descriptor, omx-balancer.descriptor.json, has no word for (docs/declaration-as-descriptor.md). The two are the folder's hand-written files; tools/gen.mjs generates the rest and writes the travels the descriptor's links resolve to. Its parameters are by reference to omx-contract's balancer kernel and bind by name to omx-dsp's instance face. Control order, the descriptor's, is append-only.

console.$comment: The OpenMixer console has no spectral balancer stage. Racked as a plugin in a channel's insert rack, it is drawn by the generic plugin editor.
